description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations related to the File management system, including access control, URL alteration, MIME type mapping, archiver info, and file transfer registration.

methods.name: hook_file_download
methods.description: Controls access to private file downloads and sets HTTP headers based on URI scheme and target.

methods.name: hook_file_url_alter
methods.description: Rewrites file URLs to serve from different CDNs based on user and file extension.

methods.name: hook_file_mimetype_mapping_alter
methods.description: Modifies MIME type mappings, adding custom types and overriding existing ones.

methods.name: hook_archiver_info_alter
methods.description: Adds 'tgz' extension support to existing archivers.

methods.name: hook_filetransfer_info
methods.description: Registers available FileTransfer classes, e.g., SFTP.

methods.name: hook_filetransfer_info_alter
methods.description: Modifies the FileTransfer class registry, removing FTP and prioritizing SSH.
